description:
### 1. Overall Layout
The diagram features a highly compact, visually balanced horizontal layout designed to fit neatly within a single column of a two-column academic paper (aspect ratio roughly 3:1, width to height). The visual flow is primarily left-to-right, anchored by three main structural columns: Input on the far left, Processing in the center, and Storage on the far right. Vertically, the diagram is split into an upper path representing "Context Retrieval" and a lower path representing "Tool Retrieval," both converging cleanly on the central processing unit. The design employs a generous use of intentional whitespace to separate the phases clearly.

### 2. Components
*   **Input Node (Left):** A minimalist document icon located on the far left, featuring a crisp dark charcoal outline and a solid white fill. It is explicitly labeled **"New Task"** in a bold, modern sans-serif font (such as Roboto or Helvetica) placed just below or next to the icon.
*   **Central Processing Unit (Center):** A single, softly rounded rectangular container positioned in the exact center of the diagram. It is filled with a very pale, cool grey (approximately 10-15% opacity) with a delicate solid dark charcoal border. It is labeled **"Agent"** at the top center in bold sans-serif. The interior is divided horizontally by a single, ultra-fine line, creating two stacked vertical sections: the top section is labeled **"Prompt"** and the bottom section is labeled **"Execution"**, both in a medium-weight sans-serif font.
*   **Knowledge Base (Right):** A clean, minimalist cylindrical database icon positioned on the far right, symmetrically aligned with the input node. It features a crisp dark charcoal outline and a stark white fill, labeled **"Memory KB"** in bold sans-serif.
*   **CR Module (Top Center):** A softly rounded rectangular box situated above the central Agent, filled with a soft, pale sky blue. It contains the bold text **"CR"** with a smaller sub-text directly beneath it reading **"task-level similarity"** in a regular-weight sans-serif font.
*   **TR Module (Bottom Center):** A softly rounded rectangular box situated below the central Agent, filled with a gentle pale amber or soft warm yellow. It contains the bold text **"TR"** with a smaller sub-text directly beneath it reading **"issue-level hybrid"** in a regular-weight sans-serif font.

### 3. Connections
*All connections should utilize smooth, softly routed lines (using rounded orthogonal elbows or gentle bezier curves) rather than harsh, sharp diagonals.*
*   **Upper Path (Context Retrieval Flow):**
    *   A thin, crisp dark charcoal solid line with a precise arrowhead flows upward and to the right from the "New Task" icon to the "CR" box.
    *   A thin, solid dark charcoal line flows upward and to the left from the "Memory KB" icon to the "CR" box.
    *   A thin, solid dark charcoal line flows directly downward from the "CR" box, terminating with an arrowhead inside the top **"Prompt"** section of the central Agent.
*   **Lower Path (Tool Retrieval Flow):**
    *   A thin, crisp dark charcoal *dashed* line (indicating auxiliary/trigger flow) flows directly downward from the bottom **"Execution"** section of the central Agent to the "TR" box.
    *   A thin, solid dark charcoal line flows downward and to the left from the "Memory KB" icon to the "TR" box.
    *   A thin, solid dark charcoal line flows directly upward from the "TR" box, looping back with an arrowhead into the **"Execution"** section of the central Agent.

### 4. Groupings
*   **Context Retrieval Loop (Upper Region):** The elements above the central midline (the CR box and its incoming/outgoing arrows) are conceptually grouped by their shared upper routing and soft sky blue color coding, representing the initial retrieval phase.
*   **Tool Retrieval Loop (Lower Region):** The elements below the central midline (the TR box and its incoming/outgoing arrows) form a secondary, feedback-driven retrieval phase, unified by the pale amber color coding.
*   **Agent Container:** The "Prompt" and "Execution" phases are strictly grouped together inside the single, unified boundary of the pale grey "Agent" rectangle, utilizing a macro-micro visual pattern to show they are sub-processes of a single entity.

### 5. Labels and Annotations
*   **Upper Path Annotations:** The arrow flowing from "Memory KB" to the "CR" box features a small, neatly aligned text label reading **"Top-k learnings"**. Near the overall CR module path, there is a small, standalone annotation reading **"at start"** in a slightly muted charcoal tone to distinguish it from structural labels.
*   **Lower Path Annotations:** The upward arrow flowing from the "TR" box into the "Execution" section features a small, neatly aligned text label reading **"Top-3 solutions"**. Near the overall TR module path, there is a small, standalone annotation reading **"need-based"** in a slightly muted charcoal tone.
*   **Typography:** All text utilizes a clean, highly legible sans-serif font to maintain a strict, modern academic appearance. Main component labels are bolded, while sub-text and arrow annotations use a smaller, regular weight.

### 6. Input/Output
*   **System Input:** The entire flow is initiated by the "New Task" document entering from the left.
*   **Data Flows:** Knowledge data is extracted from the "Memory KB" on the right. It is processed into "Top-k learnings" (outputting to the Prompt) and "Top-3 solutions" (outputting to the Execution phase). 
*   **Triggers:** The execution phase outputs a trigger (via the dashed arrow) to the TR module, which in turn pulls new data from the Memory KB to feed back into the execution phase.

### 7. Styling
*   **Background:** Pure white background to ensure absolute clarity, clean modularity, and high contrast for academic print.
*   **Color Palette:** Fills strictly follow a "Soft Tech & Scientific Pastels" aesthetic. Fully saturated backgrounds are avoided; colors are used to group logic rather than decorate.
    *   The **"CR"** box uses a soft, pale sky blue.
    *   The **"TR"** box uses a gentle pale amber.
    *   The central **"Agent"** rounded rectangle uses a subtle, light cool grey.
*   **Line Weights:** All borders, dividers, and arrows are drawn with thin, crisp, dark charcoal lines (avoiding heavy, pure black "PowerPoint default" outlines). The dividing line between Prompt and Execution is exceptionally fine.
*   **Aesthetic:** The diagram strictly adheres to a minimalist, information-dense academic style (akin to Nature or Science journal figures). It is entirely 2D flat design—there are absolutely no drop shadows, gradients, 3D effects, or unnecessary decorative elements.
